def main():
    settings = load_settings()
    if not settings.streetsmart_username:
        username = str('').strip()
    else:
        username = str(settings.streetsmart_username).strip()
    if not settings.streetsmart_password:
        password = str('')
    else:
        password = str(settings.streetsmart_password)
    initial_state = _load_state()
    initial_selection = _selection_from_state(initial_state)
    menu = [Menu('Navigatie', [MenuAction('Terug', _browser_go_back),
        MenuAction('Start', _browser_go_home), MenuAction('Naar selectie',
        _browser_go_selection), MenuSeparator(), MenuAction('Vernieuwen',
        _browser_refresh)])]
    webview.settings['OPEN_EXTERNAL_LINKS_IN_BROWSER'] = False
    webview.settings['SHOW_DEFAULT_MENUS'] = False
    window = webview.create_window(_window_title(initial_selection), url=
        _selection_url(initial_selection), width=WINDOW_WIDTH, height=
        WINDOW_HEIGHT, min_size=WINDOW_MIN_SIZE, text_select=True,
        background_color='#FFFFFF', menu=menu)

        return _inject_browser_script(window, username, password)

    return None
